result.summary: Found 2 visually problematic areas: a major contrast issue in the promo banner and a layout overlap where the bottom navigation obscures content.

issues.description: The promo banner text is extremely low contrast against the pale green background, making the headline and subtext hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text color or use a more opaque/darker banner background so the copy meets contrast guidelines and remains legible.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the content feed, partially hiding the next restaurant card at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/inset to the scrollable content so the last items are fully visible above the navigation bar.
